decisions.reason: The modular plant concept leverages existing shredding and screening knowledge and shows quantified customer savings, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
The specific customer success and quantified savings indicate strong market validation and learning, making a drop unlikely.
As a core slow-speed shredder with dedicated web presence, it builds directly on established knowledge and warrants continued support.
The new slow-speed shredder line closely extends existing shredder expertise and has a dedicated page, so the firm can assimilate and improve it.
Mobile spiral shaft screens are adjacent to existing screening technologies and have a dedicated page, suggesting the firm can apply its related capabilities.
